notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
description:
Declare Corridor Monitor as an attacker, triggering its myriad ability.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Corridor Monitor's myriad trigger.
Resolve the copy of Corridor Monitor's myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor that is tapped and attacking each other opponent.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Thran Dynamo and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.
